entry_points.text: Enable/disable bracket; init validates with distinct negatives; mapped/unmapped observe; idx default0; sched switches; aux setup/free; add/del reserve/release, read refreshes, start/stop control, txn defers checks.
Branch request and type saving tested. Sampling when period nonzero; software via cap; exclusive via unit. Sw fires on key; sched in/out emit switch samples.

Guest state/IP/PT/mediated via patchable call. Callchain appends with bounds and saturation stop. Arch classifies user/kernel, fetches IP, exposes regs. Reg validation empty-only, ABI none. Console ok, CXL inactive.
Disabled: aux acquire none/skip invalid; task init ok; lookup/read invalid; sw none; enable/disable none; debug/lowpower none.

exports.text: PMU tail gives snapshot, filter validate/sync, aux match, CPU skip, period check in PMI/process/start/open contexts. Overflow starts with event; branch snapshot takes array; typed output forwards value.
Sysfs builds event and format entries. PM defines tables, exports them and conditions pointers on config.

hazards.text: Null-check optional hooks; NMI nonblocking; idempotent stop/del for nested reads, async aux and txn rollback; unsynced validate, serialized sync; tolerate PMI preemption.

invariants.text: PMCR mask covers 8 bits minus count; overflow unions event/cycle/fault; user omits fine bit. Null device all-ones; PMEVN valid 0-30.

Samples init period plus address when nonzero; raw pads to 8 and branch clamps; total sums header plus dynamic. Paranoid above -1; guest needs active; branch/aux/backward/filter tests; child uses parent; period invalid, pause/exclusion ok, allows via capability.
When available enable gates device tracing; suspend tracing exists.
Uses external warn, list, lockdep, capability and error-pointer helpers.

locks.text: Context check warns once if interrupts enabled without mutex else empty; sibling walk asserts then iterates only from group leader.

state_machines.text: HES stopped0 uptodate1 arch2; sampling last/left atomic, topdown metric/slots. EF start1 reload2 update4 pause8 resume10 with add/stop/del/read ordering IRQ-disabled NMI-safe. Event dead-5 revoked-4 exit-3 error-2 off-1 inactive0 active1.
System and runtime map suspend/resume pairs to slots; setters install only when on else empty.

structs.text: ARM IMPDEF codes 0x40 L1D to 0xA8 L3D sparse with gaps after 0x48, in L2, around branch/exception and between RC and L3.
PMCR bits0-7 plus N11-15; overflow events0-30 cycle31 fault32; evtype event0-15 TH32-43 TC61-63; EL bits26-31; user bits0-4; slot/bus/width fields.

ARCH low28 plus user31; txn add1 read2; 12 caps 1-0x800; scope0-6; evcaps bits0-3; swevent 8b 256; attach context1 group2 exclusive128; guest1/2; security0-3; mem-NA combined; extregs0; cpu null; addr stop0 start1 filter2.

Callchain count plus flexible IPs; raw overlays next/pad with copy/data/size, last when pad under 8; branch count plus hw index; extra config/reg/alloc/idx; hw overlays live/aux/timer/trace/power/bp/iommu then target/filters/state/counters; swevent heads plus RCU; unit lock plus list; filter path/offset/size/action plus head and ranges.

PMU list plus lock module/dev attrs name/type caps/scope percpu exclusive numbers slab, IRQ-disabled prog. Event context/sibling/RB/migration/hash caps/leader/state counts/times/attr/hw/ctx/refs/child/cpu/owner map/ring/RCU/wait/async/work/filter/aux/destroy/ns/id/clock/overflow/BPF/trace/cgroup/sideband. Unit ctx plus active test; groups tree plus index; ctx lock/mutex/lists/trees/counts/task/clocks/gens; ext RCU/ref/slab; percpu sched/timer; cpu task/online/heap; handle event/buffer/wakeup/flags/addr/page; BPF regs/sample/event; cgroup derived from task; sample aligned header plus payload; guest hooks.
Sysfs pairs attr with id/string; regs hold ABI tag plus snapshot; power message int code; pm ops span prepare/complete early/late/noirq suspend/freeze/poweroff/resume plus runtime.
